frequency.description: The frequency to check branches for updates and trigger {@link JarvisService.Build}s.

onlyTriggerBuildsManually.description: Only triggers builds manually rather than on a scheduled frequency.

buildWithNoPr.description:
Trigger builds for all branches, regardless of the presence of a pull request.
If false, only branches with open pull requests will be built.

triggerIfNoDiffWithPrevious.description: Triggers builds for branches even if the branch has not had a new commit since the last build.

dataDuration.description:
The amount of time to persist build data.
NOTE: {@link Jarvis.Build.Result} is never deleted.

keepForever.description: If true, build data will be kept forever.

maxBuildRetention.description:
The maximum number of builds to retain data for a particular {@link Jarvis.Branch}.
NOTE: {@link Jarvis.Build.Result} is never deleted.

shaAgeThreshold.description: The maximum {@link SourceControlCommit#sha} age for which {@link Jarvis} will trigger a {@link Jarvis.Build}

maxConcurrentBuilds.description: The maximum amount of concurrent builds allowed for branches in this branch group

serverVersion.description:
The server version to use for builds triggered by this branch group.
If multiple {@link Jarvis.BranchGroup}s match a {@link Jarvis.Branch}, the highest version will be used.

preReleaseTag.description:
A tag to be used at the beginning of the {@link SemanticVersion#preReleaseVersion} for artifacts generated
during builds for this branch group.

firstStepName.description:
The name of the first {@link Jarvis.Lambda} that should be executed.
The default step is 'generatePackageSteps', which is run after 'stashRepo'

enableJsServerCoverage.description: Whether to enable and collect coverage data for JS server files.

enableC3UiCoverage.description: Whether to enable and collect coverage data for C3 UI files.

enablePythonCoverage.description: Whether to enable and collect coverage data for Python files.

enableJepCoverage.description:
Whether to enable and collect Python coverage data for JEP. Only applicable if {@link #enableCodeCoverageReports} is
true.
NOTE: Python code coverage is not fully supported for JEP interpreters, meaning there would be test failures
caused by this and the coverage data may not be accurate for failing tests.

title: Configuration for how a branch group should be triggered and built
name: Jarvis.BranchGroup.TriggerOptions
